detail.longDescription: # Apple says it's tightening # macOS 'Full Disk Access' controls due to new risks from # AIagents # AI that runs on desktop allow users to provide their respective apps with greater access to the files, messages, and other personal content on by adjusting macOS settings. “Some developers are using Full Disk Access in ways that could put users at risk, exposing everything on their systems…without users’ full knowledge and understanding,” Apple said. https:// techcrunch.com/2026/10/02/appl e-says-its-tightening-macos-full-disk-access-controls-due-to-new-risks-from-ai-agents/ https:// archive.ph/BLQDq
